clauses.quote: teachers' and psychologists' salary schedules and length of work year calendar shall remain the same as during 2004-2005 (180 instructional days, 2 duty days, 3 staff development days).
clauses.subject_text: teachers' and psychologists' salary schedules and length of work year calendar

clauses.quote: The District may re-open the negotiations for salaries for 2005-2006 if the state reduces the funded base revenue limit per ADA or if enrollment declines by more than 1200.

For school year 2006-2007 the teachers’ and psychologists’ salary schedule shall be increased (restored) 4% (four percent) reflecting the overall reduction to the teachers’ and psychologists’ from 2002-2003.
clauses.subject_text: the teachers’ and psychologists’ salary schedule

clauses.quote: In addition, the 2006-2007 will be increased by the same percentage as any funded COLA provided by the state to the base revenue limit per ADA received by the District during the 2004-2005 and 2005-2006 school years.
clauses.notes: Truncated subject refers to salary schedule.

clauses.quote: Any other changes to the base revenue limit will be considered within the re-opener for 2006-07.
clauses.subject_text: Any other changes to the base revenue limit

clauses.quote: The 2006-2007 calendar shall be 186 work days (180 instructional days, 3 duty days, 3 staff development days).
Work days for non-186 day unit members’ calendars shall be increased by one day from 2005-2006.
clauses.subject_text: Work days for non-186 day unit members’ calendars

clauses.quote: The Association may re-open negotiations for salaries for 2006-2007.
Beginning in 2001-2002 the psychologists' salary schedule shall be modified so that Step 11 is reached during year 11 of eligible service and Step 16 is reached during year 16 of eligibility service.
An ROP Salary Study Committee shall be convened with the purpose of creating a salary schedule for ROP teachers which will be incorporated into this Agreement if ratified.
Unit members employed on a part-time basis shall be paid in accordance with Education Code 45025.
clauses.subject_text: Unit members employed on a part-time basis

clauses.quote: Unit members whose regular assignment is extended beyond their normal work year shall be paid for the additional days at their regular daily rate
clauses.subject_text: Unit members whose regular assignment is extended beyond their normal work year
clauses.notes: Extracted as separate entry due to coordination with 'and'.

clauses.quote: Unit members whose regular assignment is extended beyond their normal work year shall be credited with additional sick leave as indicated in 8.1.5.
clauses.subject_text: Unit members whose regular assignment is extended beyond their normal work year
clauses.notes: Extracted as separate entry due to coordination with 'and'.
